title: The cube returns
summary: Continue Transformation with the cube. Read its height from time; compare how far it moves, how often it returns and where its cycle begins. Build two cubes with independent phases.
review: Author correction: start with the cube. Pendulum is a comparison, not the opening tutorial object.
carry: Carry elapsed time and cycle parameters into a comparison with a recorded swing.

title: Record
subjects: Responding swing, sampling, timestamps, bounded history
summary: Compare the prescribed cube cycle with a responding pendulum. Reuse Trace to retain named position/time records and give their age visible depth. Compare coarse and fine sampling.
review: Rewritten and natively tested: cube bob, named position/time records, bounded history. The room is now an open gallery with a larger pendulum, floor projection, enlarged paintings and an accessible hand timeline.
carry: A sampled return can become spatial spacing.

title: Space
summary: Return to the grid and familiar triangles. Sample one spatial rule and predict its relief. Release the sphere over the separate collision surface.
review: Rewritten and natively tested: one static surface, the carried PointBody, and a coarse grid that misses the crests. The room now gives tray, corridor and terrain a supported route.
carry: A repeating coordinate invites inspection of its circle construction.

title: Projection
summary: Open the circular sampler used earlier. Move the same point around a circle, project its coordinates and predict the quarter turns.
review: Rewritten and natively tested: one centred circle function, shared angle and a graph with declared axes. Seven exhibits retained in an open gallery with a reachable angle control.
carry: A local oscillator can now be coupled to its neighbours.

title: Neighbour
summary: Carry PointBody and LineSkin into nine vertical oscillators. Raise the centre. Read one shared old state before committing the next; compare coupled and independent motion, then test seven points and half the initial height.
review: Rewritten and natively tested: 28 printed-code checks, three rejected faults and 54 actual-museum checks. All five exhibits retained in separate bays. Distinguish neighbour coupling from the prescribed radial field.
carry: A rule can let one oscillation affect another.

title: Modulation
summary: Use one sine inside another’s phase. Retain a reference, change depth, predict a sample and listen through a declared encoder.
review: Preserve the accurate phase-modulation distinction despite the artifact’s FM name.
carry: The same periodic coordinates can also build a surface.

title: Twist
summary: Return to Primitives’ rings and connectivity. Rotate successive profiles by different angles. Stop whole-object rotation and inspect the twist that remains.
review: Replace the old breathing-mesh framing with the installed shaft’s construction.
carry: Distinguish a stored spatial pattern from events arriving in time.

title: Event
summary: Compose from a declared vocabulary. Keep chosen events and their times, then replay the record before asking for another.
review: Current reflection is useful. Tutorial needs a bounded score; do not claim a microphone or a Cage score.
carry: A strike supplies an event whose response has its own age.

title: Voice
summary: Strike one voice, then another. Keep each voice’s start time. Compare overlapping voices with restriking a voice whose buffer restarts.
review: Keep the distinction between a synthesised response and a physical bar model.
carry: Sampling and timing also determine a route a body can use.

title: Footing
summary: Reuse the circular sampler to place a few treads. Compare centre spacing with inner and outer edges. Inspect the collision that actually supports the visitor.
review: Remove archived alternative-stair material from the tutorial when rewriting.
carry: A regular rule can still give unequal conditions across its extent.

title: Beat
summary: Sample two close frequencies at shared times. Keep A, B and their raw sum; predict reinforcement before normalising any drawing.
review: Separate the beat exhibit from the finite circulating path; remove the obsolete endless-path proposal.
carry: Two components become a finite recipe of many components.

title: Compose
subjects: Harmonic coefficients, shared phase, finite sum
summary: Store five coefficients and evaluate every term at one time. Retain another recipe and compare. State what the restricted coefficient set cannot express.
review: Keep room-memory listening as another encounter, not a hidden audio dependency of the five-term lesson.
carry: Carry explicit recipes and limits into the next sequence.
